run_nerf_evaluation: run the main function to evaluate a NeRF model checkpoint on a test dataset
run_nerf_video_export: run the main function to export rendered frames as an MP4 video from a NeRF checkpoint
create_radiancfieldrenderer: create a RadianceFieldRenderer model with configurable ray sampler and implicit function parameters
load_nerf_checkpoint: load a NeRF model checkpoint and restore state dict excluding cached xy grid
generate_eval_video_cameras: generate evaluation video cameras with configurable trajectory type, scene center, and frame count
